tests.expect: (()=>{const ks=Object.keys(ggStore()).filter(k=>ggOf(k).length);const u=ks[ks.length-1];const L=ggOf(u);const k=L[0].k;L[0].cs=Array.from({length:20},(_,i)=>({k:'c_gate'+i,t:'관문 시험 댓글 '+i,ts:1}));ggSaveList(u,L);const me=ks[0]===u?'Q0001':ks[0];const ta=document.createElement('textarea');ta.id='refgg-cin-'+me+'-'+u+'-'+k;ta.value='관문 21번째';document.body.appendChild(ta);ggRefReply(me,u,k,'');const n=ggOf(u).find(x=>x&&x.k===k).cs.length;ta.remove();return n===21||JSON.stringify({n:n})})()
